def factor_size_trend_value_short(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    pe = df_copy["pe_ttm"].replace(0, np.nan)
    cheapness = 1.0 / pe
    cheapness = cheapness.where(cheapness > 0, np.nan)
    size = np.log1p(df_copy["mkt_cap_float"].abs())
    size_ma = size.rolling(40, min_periods=14).mean()
    size_dev = (size - size_ma) / size_ma.replace(0, np.nan)
    signal = cheapness * (-size_dev)
    signal = signal.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan)
    return pd.Series(signal, index=df_copy.index, name="factor_size_trend_value_short")
